subject: Computer Aided Civil Drawing
chapters: Chapter 3: Comp uter Aided Civil Engineering Drawings

questions.text: Explain the advantages of Computer Aided Design and Drafting (CADD) over traditional manual drafting in civil engineering projects. Explain CAD coordinate systems: Absolute Coordinate System $(X, Y)$, Relative Rectangular Coordinate System $(@\Delta X, \Delta Y)$, and Relative Polar Coordinate System $(@\text{Distance} < \text{Angle})$.
Explain CAD Environment setup: `LIMITS`, `UNITS`, `GRID`, `SNAP`, `ORTHO`, `OSNAP` (Object Snap: Endpoint, Midpoint, Center, Intersection, Perpendicular, Tangent), and dynamic input.

Explain Layer Management in AutoCAD: Layer Name, Color, Linetype (`LTSCALE`), Lineweight, On/Off, Freeze/Thaw, Lock/Unlock, and Plot/No-Plot. Why is standard layer structuring essential in architectural drawing submissions to municipal authorities (e.g. Kathmandu Valley Development Authority - KVDA)?

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Comp uter Aided Civil Engineering Drawings
questions.text: Explain Blocks and Attributes: `BLOCK`, `WBLOCK`, `INSERT`, `ATTDEF` (Attribute Definition), and `BEDIT` (Block Editor). How are title blocks and dynamic doors/windows created with attributes?

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Comp uter Aided Civil Engineering Drawings
questions.text: Prepare a complete Architectural Working Drawing set for a two-story residential building conforming to National Building Code (NBC) and municipal bylaws: (a) Ground Floor Plan and First Floor Plan showing room dimensions, wall thicknesses, door/window schedules (b) Front Elevation and Side Elevation (c) Longitudinal and Cross Section through staircase and toilet showing footing, plinth, sill, lintel, and roof slab levels (d) Site Plan showing plot boundary, setback lines ($1.5\,\text{m}-3.0\,\text{m}$), access road, and north arrow.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Comp uter Aided Civil Engineering Drawings
questions.text: Prepare structural reinforcement layout for a Doglegged RCC Staircase showing waisab thickness, main bottom bars, distribution bars, top negative bars, and landing support details.

Explain 3D Solid Modeling operations in AutoCAD: `EXTRUDE`, `PRESSPULL`, `REVOLVE`, `LOFT`, `SWEEP`, and Boolean operations (`UNION`, `SUBTRACT`, `INTERSECT`). Model a 3D isometric view of a residential building.

Explain User Coordinate System (UCS) in 3D CAD (`UCS` by 3 points, Face UCS, World Coordinate System - WCS) and 3D navigation (`3DORBIT`, `VIEWCUBE`, Visual Styles: Wireframe, Conceptual, Realistic, Shaded).

Explain Building Information Modeling (BIM) principles: 3D parametric modeling, 4D time scheduling, 5D cost estimating, 6D sustainability, and 7D facility management. Compare CAD (AutoCAD) vs BIM (Revit / ArchiCAD).
Explain View Navigation tools in CAD: `ZOOM` (All, Window, Extents, Realtime, Dynamic), `PAN`, `VIEWPORTS`, and Model Space vs Paper Space (`LAYOUT` / `TILEMODE`).
Explain Dimensioning in CAD: Linear, Aligned, Angular, Radius, Diameter, Leader (`MLEADER`), and `DIMSTYLE` customization (Dimension text, arrows, scale factor, primary units, tolerance).
Explain CAD drawing export, plotting, and printing: Page Setup Manager, Plot Styles (`monochrome.ctb` vs `acad.ctb`), scale setting ($1:50, 1:100$), and PDF/DWF export.
